# Load packages

```{r}
# Note: In case of dependency issues, Run: update.packages(ask = FALSE, checkBuilt = TRUE)
# install.packages('rlang')

#' Ensure specified packages are installed and loaded.
#'
#' Checks if packages are installed, installs missing ones,
#' then attempts to load all specified packages. Uses '=' for assignment.
#'
#' @param pkg_list A character vector of package names.
#' @return Invisibly returns a named logical vector indicating load success for each package.
load_packages = function(pkg_list) {
  
  # Ensure package list is unique
  pkg_list = unique(pkg_list)
  
  # Identify installed packages
  installed_pkgs = rownames(installed.packages())
  
  # Find packages that need installation
  missing_pkgs = pkg_list[!pkg_list %in% installed_pkgs]
  
  # Install missing packages if any exist
  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    message("Installing missing packages: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
    tryCatch({
      install.packages(missing_pkgs, dependencies = TRUE)
      # Update the list of known installed packages *after* installation attempt
      installed_pkgs = rownames(installed.packages()) 
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Installation failed for some packages: ", conditionMessage(e))
    })
  }
  
  message("Loading required packages...")
  # Attempt to load all packages in the list
  load_status = sapply(pkg_list, function(pkg) {
    # Check if it's actually installed before trying to load
    if (pkg %in% installed_pkgs) {
      # Use require() as it returns TRUE/FALSE, suitable for sapply
      # suppressPackageStartupMessages keeps the console cleaner
      loaded = suppressPackageStartupMessages(
        require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)
      )
      if (!loaded) {
        warning("Failed to load package: ", pkg)
      }
      return(loaded)
    } else {
      # If it's not in installed_pkgs (even after install attempt)
      warning("Package '", pkg, "' not found or failed to install. Cannot load.")
      return(FALSE)
    }
  })
  
  # Report final status
  if (all(load_status)) {
    message("All required packages loaded successfully.")
  } else {
    failed_pkgs = names(load_status[!load_status])
    warning("Failed to load or install the following packages: ",
            paste(failed_pkgs, collapse = ", "), ".")
  }
  
  # Return the status invisibly (useful for checking programmatically if needed)
  invisible(load_status)
}


# --- Usage ---
```

# Loop for Modeling

```{r}
# Initialize windows
period_keys <- c("20200315_20200627", "20200322_20200523", "20200412_20200523")
suffixes <-c("_March_15_June_27", "_March_22_May_23", "_April_12_May_23")
stringency_keys <- c("march_15_june_30", "march_22_may_23", "april_12_may_23")

# # For trial check . Uncomment if you want to check
# period_keys <- c("20200315_20200627")
# suffixes <-c("_March_15_June_27")
# stringency_keys <- c("march_15_june_30")
# i = 1

results_est_list <- list()
results_hicc_list <- list()
results_weight_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(period_keys)) {
  
  
  # Get train, test and full sample data
  assign("train_data_df", get(paste0("train_data_df", tolower(suffixes[i]))))
  assign("test_data_df", get(paste0("test_data_df", tolower(suffixes[i]))))
  assign("cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency", get(paste0("cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency", tolower(suffixes[i]))))
  

  # Weights
  qgcomp_weights_train = train_data_df$observation_wt_trim 
  qgcomp_weights_test  = test_data_df$observation_wt_trim 
  qgcomp_weights_total_sample = cope_auo_july_no_miss_w_stringency$observation_wt_trim
  
  # All components model to estimate pos and neg components ---------------------------------
  ## get formula
  static_covariates <- c("age_2020",
                         "home",
                         "maritalstatus",
                         "race",
                         "education",
                         "employment",
                         "insurance",
                         "anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                         "anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid",
                         "sex",
                         "birthplace",
                         "generalized_anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                         "generalized_anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid")
  
  dynamic_covariates_master <- paste0("C", 1:7, "M", suffixes[i])
  exposure_names_master <- paste0("C", 1:7, "M", suffixes[i])
  full_covariates_base <- static_covariates
  exposure_names <- exposure_names_master
  
  ## init df
  result_df <- data.frame(
    sr_no = integer(),
    period = character(),
    components = character(),
    exposures = character(),
    beta = numeric(),
    p_val = numeric(),
    lower_ci = numeric(),
    upper_ci = numeric(),
    p_value_out = numeric(),
    exposure_out = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  
  
  # Loop for BACKWARD SELECTION
  while (length(exposure_names) >= 2) {
    
    # Define formula for current exposures
    fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(c(full_covariates_base, exposure_names), collapse = " + ")))
    
    # Fit model
    qgcomp_all_components <- qgcomp.glm.noboot(
      f = fml,
      expnms = exposure_names, 
      data = train_data_df, 
      weights = qgcomp_weights_train,
      q = NULL,
      bayes = FALSE
    )
    
    # Extract components
    ## all components
    all_list <- sub(pattern = paste0(suffixes[i], "$"), 
                    replacement = "", 
                    x = qgcomp_all_components$expnms)
    
    ## pos components
    pos_list <- sub(pattern = paste0(suffixes[i], "$"), 
                    replacement = "", 
                    x = names(qgcomp_all_components$pos.weights))
    
    ## neg components
    neg_list <- sub(pattern = paste0(suffixes[i], "$"), 
                    replacement = "", 
                    x = names(qgcomp_all_components$neg.weights))
    
    ## Final exposure list
    exposure_list <- list(
                         all_list,
                         pos_list,
                         neg_list
                         )
    
    ## Get length of exposures
    sr_no <- length(all_list)
    
    # Term to remove next loop
    ## Get coefficients and p-values
    regression_results <- broom::tidy(qgcomp_all_components$fit)
    
    ## Filter to only exposure terms (match names)
    result_exposures <- regression_results[regression_results$term %in% exposure_names, ]
    
    ## Drop exposure with highest p-value
    term_to_drop <- result_exposures$term[which.max(result_exposures$p.value)]
    p_value_out <- result_exposures$p.value[which.max(result_exposures$p.value)]
    exposure_names <- setdiff(exposure_names, term_to_drop)
    
    cat("Dropped:", term_to_drop, "\nRemaining:", paste(exposure_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    
    
    # Get excel
    ## Create or load the workbook
    if (!exists("wb")) {
      wb <- createWorkbook()
    }
    
    ## Set digit format
    options("openxlsx.numFmt" = "0.000")
    
    ## Define sheet name
    sheet_name <- paste0("be", suffixes[i], "_", sr_no)
    
    ## Add sheet to workbook
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
    
    ## Write the data to the sheet
    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = regression_results)
    
    ## Auto-adjust column widths
    setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(regression_results), widths = "auto")
    
    ## Identify relevant columns
    pval_col <- which(names(regression_results) == "p.value")
    est_col  <- which(names(regression_results) == "estimate")
    
    ## Apply conditional formatting for p val
    if (!is.na(pval_col) && length(pval_col) > 0) {
      conditionalFormatting(
        wb, sheet = sheet_name,
        cols = pval_col,
        rows = 2:(nrow(regression_results) + 1),  # +1 for header
        rule = "<0.05",
        style = createStyle(fontColour = "black", bgFill = "#63BE7B")
      )
    }
    
    ## Apply conditional formatting for estimates
    if (!is.na(est_col) && length(est_col) > 0) {
      conditionalFormatting(
        wb, sheet = sheet_name,
        cols = est_col,
        rows = 2:(nrow(regression_results) + 1),
        type = "colourScale",
        style = c("#F8696B", "#FFFFFF", "#63BE7B")  # red-white-green scale
      )
    }
    
    for(exp in exposure_list){
    
      # Define variables
      static_covariates <- c("age_2020",
                             "home",
                             "maritalstatus",
                             "race",
                             "education",
                             "employment",
                             "insurance",
                             "anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                             "anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid",
                             "sex",
                             "birthplace",
                             "generalized_anxiety_disorder_before_covid_lifetime",
                             "generalized_anxiety_disorder_1yr_before_covid")
      
      # Init consolidation setting
      consolidation_set = FALSE
      
      # Get formula
      exp_vals <- if (is.character(exp) && length(exp) == 1 && exists(exp)) get(exp) else exp
      
      
      if (identical(exp_vals, all_list)) {
        consolidation_name <- "all_components"
      } else if (identical(exp_vals, pos_list)) {
        consolidation_name <- "pos_components"
      } else if (identical(exp_vals, neg_list)) {
        consolidation_name <- "neg_components"
      }
      
      # Empty list
      # Handle empty exposure case (for pos/neg)
      if (length(exp_vals) == 0) {
        result_df <- rbind(result_df, data.frame(
          sr_no = sr_no,
          period = suffixes[i],
          components = consolidation_name,
          exposures = NA,
          beta = NA,
          p_val = NA,
          lower_ci = NA,
          upper_ci = NA,
          p_value_out = p_value_out,
          exposure_out = short_term_to_drop,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ))
      } else {
        

        
      print(paste0("Processing for ", consolidation_name))
      dynamic_covariates <- c(paste0(all_list, suffixes[i]))
      exposure_names_comp_loop <- c(paste0(all_list, suffixes[i]))
      exposures_to_extract <- c(paste0(exp_vals, suffixes[i]))
      full_covariates <- c(static_covariates, dynamic_covariates)
      fml <- as.formula(paste("gad_score_july ~", paste(full_covariates, collapse = " + ")))
        
      
      # Model
      model_qgcomp <- qgcomp.glm.noboot(f = fml,
                                        expnms = exposure_names_comp_loop, 
                                        data = test_data_df, 
                                        weights = qgcomp_weights_test,
                                        q = NULL,
                                        bayes = FALSE) 
      
      ## Robust
      robust_df <- qgcomp.robust.est(fit.object = model_qgcomp$fit,
                               cluster_robust = TRUE, 
                               robust_type = "HC1", 
                               cluster_var = test_data_df$RegionName, 
                               exposure_names = exposures_to_extract)
      
      
      ## Get exposure names
      short_exposures <- gsub("^(C[1-7]M).*", "\\1", exposures_to_extract)
      short_exposures_str <- paste(short_exposures, collapse = ", ")
      
      short_term_to_drop <- gsub("^(C[1-7]M).*", "\\1", term_to_drop)
      
      result_df <- rbind(result_df, data.frame(
                      sr_no = sr_no,
                      period = suffixes[i],
                      components = consolidation_name,
                      exposures = short_exposures_str,
                      beta = robust_df$beta,
                      p_val = robust_df$p_val,
                      lower_ci = robust_df$lower_ci,
                      upper_ci = robust_df$upper_ci,
                      p_value_out = p_value_out,
                      exposure_out = short_term_to_drop,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                    ))
      }
    }
  }
  
  
  results_est_list[[sub("^_", "", suffixes[i])]] <- result_df
  
}    

```

```{r}
# Create kable view

## Store all results
all_results <- rbindlist(results_est_list)

# ## Clean stringency values
# all_results$components <- ifelse(grepl("^stringency_", all_results$components),
#                      sub("_.*", "_index", all_results$components),
#                      all_results$components)

## Add ci column
all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(ci = paste0("(", 
                     scales::number(lower_ci, accuracy = 0.001), 
                     ", ", 
                     scales::number(upper_ci, accuracy = 0.001), 
                     ")")
         )

## View
colnames(all_results)

## Create list of data frames for each window
window_dfs <- lapply(unique(all_results$period), function(window) {
  all_results %>%
    filter(period == window) %>%
    select(sr_no, components, exposures, beta, p_val, ci, exposure_out, p_value_out) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(., "_window", window), -c(sr_no, components))
})


## Combine side by side 
final_df <- reduce(window_dfs, left_join, by = c("sr_no", "components"))

## Get p-value columns
pval_cols <- grep("^p_val_|^p_value_out$", names(final_df), value = TRUE)

## Apply bolding to those columns
final_df_bold <- final_df

for (col in pval_cols) {
  vals <- final_df[[col]]
  fmt  <- ifelse(is.na(vals), "—", sprintf("%.3f", vals))   
  bld  <- ifelse(is.na(vals), FALSE, vals < 0.05)           

  final_df_bold[[col]] <- cell_spec(fmt, format = "html", bold = bld)
}

## Save as kable
result_df_kable <- final_df_bold %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, 
               booktabs = TRUE, 
               format = "html", 
               escape = FALSE,
               caption = paste0("Quantile gcomp train to test backwared elimination results: direct fit")) %>%
  kable_styling(font_size = 15, fixed_thead = TRUE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

print(result_df_kable)
```
